gateways.name: SayGM
gateways.pricing: No subscription or top-up fee; every model at or below list price
gateways.privacy: Attested enclave gateway; -tee models sealed end to end
gateways.best: Lowest price on Claude and GPT, and on several open models

gateways.name: OpenRouter
gateways.pricing: Provider price + 5.5% fee on credit (8% on Business)
gateways.best: Widest catalogue and free models for testing

gateways.name: DeepInfra
gateways.pricing: Pay per token; Priority tier 1.5x, Flex tier 0.8x
gateways.catalog: About 180 models, incl. Claude and Gemini
gateways.privacy: No storage or training without consent

gateways.name: Requesty
gateways.pricing: Provider price + 5%; free tier of 200 requests a day
gateways.privacy: EU data residency on every plan

gateways.name: Together AI
gateways.pricing: Pay per token; cheaper batch rates
gateways.catalog: 200+ models, incl. image, video and audio
gateways.privacy: No training without opt-in; zero retention available

gateways.name: Cheaper Inference
gateways.catalog: 571 models, incl. image, video and audio

gateways.name: Venice
gateways.pricing: Pay per token; also daily credit from staked VVV/DIEM tokens, or USDC per request
gateways.catalog: 148 text models, plus image, video and audio
gateways.privacy: Anonymized proxy for Claude, GPT and Gemini (provider may still see prompts); zero-retention and end-to-end encrypted options for open models
gateways.best: Privacy-first use, incl. end-to-end encrypted open models
